india.one_line: India sees new AI infrastructure investments, local agent integrations, enterprise milestones, and impending government regulations.

themes.title: AI agents and models expand in India
themes.text: Entire partnered with Sarvam to offer locally hosted AI coding agents, IBM Research built an Indic regional voice agent, and Anthropic expanded its Claude Duet AI agent research preview to India.

stories.headline: Entire partners with Sarvam to bring AI coding agents to India
IBM Research builds Indic voice agent using CUGA harness
Anthropic expands Claude Duet AI agent research preview to India

themes.title: Enterprise AI adoption and funding grow
themes.text: BP partnered with Wipro to transfer thousands of finance staff for an AI transformation deal, AidenAI raised $32 million in Series A funding, and Infosys achieved CMMI AI Maturity Level 5.

stories.headline: BP to transfer 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in AI transformation deal
AidenAI raises $32M Series A to expand enterprise AI platform
Infosys reaches CMMI AI Maturity Level 5, first organization worldwide

themes.title: Government policy and regulatory updates
themes.text: MeitY announced that upcoming AI regulation papers are in their final stages alongside the launch of the Chariot-1 Foundation Models, while confirming no misuse of IndiaAI support by Sarvam.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
Government finds no misuse of IndiaAI support in Sarvam Chinese model row

themes.title: Infrastructure fund targets India projects
themes.text: Nexent Capital launched a $1 billion fund to invest in AI data-center and energy infrastructure in North America and India.

stories.headline: Nexent Capital launches $1 billion fund for AI data‑center and energy infrastructure
